survey: A cartoon rocket floating against a blue sunburst, with no ground. Its long axis leans to the upper right, and the camera looks at it from slightly above. Main parts: (1) A red ogive nose cone sitting on the body, with a red rim ring at the joint. The ring's front edge dips downward, so it is an ellipse seen from slightly above. (2) A silver body, a cylinder that narrows toward the bottom. Its outline follows the same leaning axis as the nose. (3) Two portholes with chrome bezels, stacked on the body's centerline. Each is a slightly squashed circle, which suits a cylinder seen nearly face-on from a little above. The upper porthole is a bit larger, matching the wider part of the body. (4) Two red swept fins, one each side of the body near the base. They point left and right, roughly across the line of sight, so they show their flat faces with a little thickness on their edges. Both join the body along its sides. (5) A dark nozzle ring at the base. Its front edge also dips downward, a slightly rounder ellipse than the nose rim, as expected for a part lower down when the camera is above. (6) A yellow flame centered under the nozzle and following the body's axis. The nose, body, nozzle and flame share one axis. Both ring ellipses curve the same way, and the fins and portholes agree with the same slightly-high camera.
